content: Nobody can fall so low unless he has a great depth. If such a thing happens, it signifies that he must now descend into his own depth.
author: Carl Jung
sourceWork: Modern Man in Search of a Soul (1933)
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. We spend enormous energy trying to present a sanitized, perfect version of ourselves to the world. But whatever emotions or desires we push into the dark don't disappear; they run our lives from behind the curtain.

Carl Jung understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. True maturity isn't pretending you have no dark corners—it is having the honesty and courage to look at your jealousy, fear, and anger in the daylight so they no longer control your actions.
reflectionPrompt: What would happen if you met today's stress with steady acceptance rather than resistance?
